on f(x, L, y)
	repeat with i in L
		tell application "Finder" to set a to (first folder of x whose name is y)
		set b to item 1 of L
		set c to x's y
		set d to f(x, L, y)
		set e to every item of L
		set g to i + 1
		set h to (items of L whose it > 1)
		set k to items 1 thru 2 of L
		set m to L as text
		set n to not y
		return (items of L whose it > 1)
	end repeat
end f
